title: Global Sets vs Zoho CRM: replacing a value that a view filter uses
label: RETEST PARTIAL vs ZOHO
env: TAVI staging-crm (NDC-Staging, owner) · Zoho CRM org944965048 (Enterprise trial, admin) · set QA RT15 GS Colors, Leads field QA RT15 GS Color, view QA RT15 2806 Green view

panels.caption: TAVI API (10 Nov): replacing a value that a view filter uses is refused; Used In lists fields and views, reports not tracked
TAVI Used In dialog: fields listed; "Reports that filter on these fields are not listed here yet."
Zoho › Edit Global Set › Replace Values Green → Red: "Existing Value will be replaced in all the used places (Records, Criteria, Workflow Actions, Field Dependency)"
After Save: the view filtered on Green now filters on Red (API criteria value "Red") and still lists the lead, now Red; Green moved to Unused
Zoho "Associated places": lists only fields by module and layout (no views, no reports)

rows: Replace a value that a custom view filter uses

Allowed: the dialog says the value is replaced in records, criteria, workflow actions and field dependencies. Green → Red changed the lead and the view filter (criteria value now Red); Green moved to Unused.
Refused: 409 GLOBAL_SET_VALUE_IN_USE "Change or remove it in those views first" — the change is not carried to the view.
Lists the fields only (module › field › layout); no views, no reports.
Lists fields and custom views; says reports are not listed yet. TAVI shows more than Zoho, so this part is not a gap vs Zoho.
